cards.text: While Apollos, a Jewish teacher from Alexandria (Acts 18:24-25), is over in Corinth, Paul, called to be an apostle (Romans 1:1), travels through the interior and comes to Ephesus. That's a long trip, friend, and I get winded hopping from one oven to the next. When Paul gets there, he finds some disciples.
No 'nice weather,' no 'love the sandals.' Paul skips the small talk and asks them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you became believers?”

cards.question: When Paul asks about the Holy Spirit, these disciples tell him they've never even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.

cards.text: So Paul asks, “Into what, then, were you baptized?” That's me with a flat batch, friend, going back to step one of the recipe.

cards.question: What baptism do these disciples in Ephesus tell Paul they received?

cards.text: Paul explains that John, the one who baptized in the wilderness (Mark 1:4), gave a baptism of repentance and told people to believe in the One coming after him. John was pointing the whole time, friend, and not at himself.

cards.question: According to Paul, who is the One coming after John that John told people to believe in?
On hearing what Paul explains, the disciples in Ephesus are baptized into the name of the Lord Jesus.

cards.text: Then Paul lays his hands on them.

cards.question: When Paul lays his hands on these disciples, what happens?

answers.text: The Holy Spirit comes on them and they speak in tongues and prophesy
A bright light flashes around them and they all fall to the ground
The whole building shakes and every door in the place flies open

cards.text: There were about twelve men in all. About a dozen, friend, and a dozen is the one number a cookie stamper NEVER gets wrong.

Then Paul goes into the synagogue and speaks boldly there for three months, arguing persuasively about the kingdom of God. Three MONTHS of persuading, friend, when I can't even persuade my oven timer to wait two more minutes.

cards.question: After three months of Paul speaking boldly in the synagogue in Ephesus, every single person there believes.

cards.text: Some of them stubbornly refuse to believe and publicly malign the Way. That's leaving a one-star review while you're still standing at the counter.

cards.question: With some in the synagogue publicly maligning the Way, what does Paul do?

answers.text: Takes his disciples to the lecture hall of Tyrannus
Sails out of Ephesus and heads back to Syria
Stays and argues in that same synagogue every day

cards.question: Paul's daily discussions in the lecture hall go on for two years. Who ends up hearing the word of the Lord?

answers.text: Everyone in the province of Asia
Only the people living in Ephesus
Only the disciples Paul brought along

cards.text: Now God does extraordinary miracles through the hands of Paul. Friend, I don't even HAVE hands, and my mustache is doing its best.

cards.question: God's miracles through Paul are so extraordinary that what gets taken to the sick?

answers.text: Handkerchiefs and aprons that had touched him
Water from the pool of Siloam
Oil that Paul had prayed over

cards.question: When the things that had touched Paul are taken to the sick, only the diseases leave them.

cards.text: APRONS, friend, and the most mine has ever done is catch flour. Now some traveling Jewish exorcists try to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over people with evil spirits.

cards.question: These traveling exorcists command the evil spirits by Jesus, whom ___ proclaims.

cards.text: Seven sons of Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, are doing this. SEVEN brothers, friend, all in the same line of work.
Then one day they try it, and the evil spirit answers back. Friend, when the thing you're commanding starts talking back, that is NEVER a good sign.

cards.question: What does the evil spirit tell the sons of Sceva?

answers.text: It knows Jesus and knows about Paul but asks who they are
It will only leave if Paul comes and tells it himself
It has never once heard anyone use the name of Jesus

cards.text: Then the man with the evil spirit jumps on them.

cards.question: When the man with the evil spirit jumps on the sons of Sceva, he overpowers all of them.
The attack is so violent that the sons of Sceva leave the house how?

answers.text: They run out naked and wounded
They are carried out in chains
They are led out blind by the hand

cards.text: This becomes known to all the Jews and Greeks living in Ephesus, and fear comes over all of them. News like that travels faster than the smell of a fresh batch, friend.

cards.question: With fear over everyone in Ephesus, whose name is held in high honor?

cards.text: Then many who had believed come forward, confessing and disclosing their deeds. Friend, if I came forward, it'd be one LONG list of cookie dough I sneaked off the counter.

cards.question: In Ephesus, what do a number of those who had practiced magic arts do with their books?

answers.text: Burn them in front of everyone

cards.text: When the value of the books is calculated, the total comes to fifty thousand drachmas. Friend, that's not a little fire, that's a FORTUNE going up in smoke.

cards.question: After all this in Ephesus, the word of the Lord powerfully continues to spread and prevail.

cards.text: Ephesus is buzzing, friend, and Paul's journey is just getting warmed up. Keep that oven on, because this story is NOT done.
